ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the electric dipole is arranged along an oblique straight line, with the origin O in the middle; the negative charge -q is located at the lower left of O, at a distance a from O; the positive charge +q is located at the upper right of O, also at a distance a from O. The observation point is located on the same straight line at the upper right of +q, at a distance r from O, with direction the same as \vec{p}. Reasoning: Take the direction along \vec{p} as the positive direction. The distance from the observation point to +q is r-a, and the distance to -q is r+a. Since r \gg a, (r^2-a^2)^2 \approx r^4, so E \approx \frac{4kaq}{r^3}. Also p=2aq, therefore 4kaq=2kp; and k=1/(4\pi\varepsilon_0), thus E_p=\frac{2p}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 r^3}, with direction along \vec{p}.

raw_record.question_text:
3.1 Calculate the electric field intensity $\vec{E}_{p}$ at a distance $r$ from an ideal electric dipole $\vec{p}$ at the origin $\mathrm{O}$ along the direction of $\vec{p}$ as shown in Figure 2.

$p=2 a q, \quad r \gg a$

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a collinear dipole: the charge -q is at distance a to the left of O, the charge +q is at distance a to the right of O, the dipole moment arrow points from -q toward +q, and the observation point lies further to the right on the same axis at distance r from O. Use the text condition p=2aq and r >> a. Apply Coulomb superposition at the observation point: the +q field points along the dipole axis with magnitude kq/(r-a)^2, while the -q field points opposite the axis with magnitude kq/(r+a)^2. Thus E = kq[(r-a)^{-2}-(r+a)^{-2}] along p. Simplify exactly to kq·4ar/(r^2-a^2)^2, then use r >> a to approximate this as 4kaq/r^3. Substitute p=2aq and k=1/(4πϵ0) to obtain E_p = 2p/(4πϵ0 r^3), directed along p.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中电偶极子沿一条斜直线排列，原点 O 在中间；负电荷 -q 位于 O 的左下方，距离 O 为 a；正电荷 +q 位于 O 的右上方，距离 O 也为 a。偶极矩 \vec{p} 的箭头从 -q 指向 +q。观察点位于 +q 右上方的同一直线上，距 O 为 r，方向与 \vec{p} 相同。

推理：取沿 \vec{p} 的方向为正方向。观察点到 +q 的距离为 r-a，到 -q 的距离为 r+a。由库仑场叠加，+q 在观察点产生的电场沿正方向，大小为 kq/(r-a)^2；-q 在观察点产生的电场沿负方向，大小为 kq/(r+a)^2。因此
E = kq\left[\frac{1}{(r-a)^2}-\frac{1}{(r+a)^2}\right]
= kq\frac{(r+a)^2-(r-a)^2}{(r^2-a^2)^2}
= kq\frac{4ar}{(r^2-a^2)^2}。
由于 r \gg a，(r^2-a^2)^2 \approx r^4，所以
E \approx \frac{4kaq}{r^3}。
又 p=2aq，故 4kaq=2kp；且 k=1/(4\pi\varepsilon_0)，于是
E_p=\frac{2p}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 r^3}，方向沿 \vec{p}。
method.model_answer: \vec{E}_p=\frac{2p}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 r^3}\,\hat{p}, i.e. the field magnitude is E_p=\frac{2p}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 r^3}, directed along \vec{p}.

By superposition of Coulomb fields, the electric field produced by +q at the observation point is along the positive direction, with magnitude kq/(r-a)^2; the electric field produced by -q at the observation point is along the negative direction, with magnitude kq/(r+a)^2. Therefore
E = kq\left[\frac{1}{(r-a)^2}-\frac{1}{(r+a)^2}\right]
= kq\frac{(r+a)^2-(r-a)^2}{(r^2-a^2)^2}
= kq\frac{4ar}{(r^2-a^2)^2}.
Since r \gg a, (r^2-a^2)^2 \approx r^4, so
E \approx \frac{4kaq}{r^3}.
Also p=2aq, therefore 4kaq=2kp; and k=1/(4\pi\varepsilon_0), thus
E_p=\frac{2p}{4\pi\varepsilon_0 r^3}, with direction along \vec{p}.
